economics.rule: contact every customer whose churn probability >= break-even

drivers.sentence: Customers with last_payment_method not in ['14', '18', '23', '31', '34', '37', '41'] (29% of customers) churn at 11.1% vs 1.0% for everyone else: 10.7x the risk.
Customers with last_auto_renew <= 0 (12% of customers) churn at 21.5% vs 1.6% for everyone else: 13.4x the risk.
Customers with last_list_price > 99 (56% of customers) churn at 6.1% vs 1.2% for everyone else: 5.0x the risk.

Customers with days_since_last_tx <= 15 (47% of customers) churn at 3.5% vs 4.3% for everyone else: 0.8x the risk. The model only treats this as risky in combination with other features; on its own the group is not riskier.
Customers with last_amount_paid > 99 (56% of customers) churn at 6.0% vs 1.4% for everyone else: 4.3x the risk.

uplift.segment_rule: persuadable / sleeping dog: predicted uplift above +/-1%; otherwise sure thing / lost cause by P(visit without e-mail) above / below median
